Hi Elliot / Quantaloft team,

Great speaking yesterday — we're excited to run a focused technical demo next week to validate the latency/cost profile and walk through integration touchpoints. To make the session useful for your team, can we confirm who from Quantaloft will attend (engineering + procurement + security)? On our side I'd like to loop in SE (Ava) and a systems engineer.

Proposed agenda (90 minutes):
- 10m introductions and goals
- 35m SE deep-dive (model routing, perf/cost knobs)
- 25m integration questions (auth, data flows, KV cache)
- 20m procurement/security Q&A + next steps

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-06-22 15:00–16:30
- Wed 2026-06-23 13:00–14:30

I've attached a short pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.xlsx) — please complete the items under 'Customer inputs' if possible. Also let me know if security requires a separate pre-call — we can schedule a 30-min run-up for them.

Ava — can you confirm SE availability and who from Infra should join?

Thanks,
